=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:672-696 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fail-closed dedup listing failure aborts the whole triage run (exit 1, reason=dedup_list_failed) before the base-branch gate at line 720 and the duplicate-skip path.
  WHY: A transient API error loses the diagnosis and turns an intended skip into a failed run. Severity disagreement: gemini=BLOCKER, glm=MAJOR; the highest is used. Sonnet-5_5 judged this intended behavior and not a defect.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:679-696 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The listing call discards stderr and the gh_retry exit status, so reason=dedup_list_failed carries no distinguishing cause.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell a rate limit from a permission error, a 5xx or a jq projection failure. Sonnet-5_5 raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3385-3449 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Failed push, fetch or rebase attempts raise before returning the clone_ms, write_ms and push_ms timing fields.
  WHY: Failure telemetry lacks the new phase timing breakdown. Sonnet-5_5 judged this out of scope for the change.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:878-880 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A failed marker-comment lookup now returns 1 without attempting any write, where the old code fell through to the POST branch.
  WHY: The released-status comment can be silently absent after a transient read failure. Sonnet-5_5 says this lookup branch is unchanged context in the diff.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:868-873 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The function contract comment and changelog.d/8127-merge-train-upsert-status.md do not document the lookup-failure behavior change.
  WHY: The behavior callers and operators observe does not match the documentation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

The five behavior changes are triage dedup fail-closed, merge-train upsert status, cross-repo candidate PR filter, label-ensure cache and memory timing telemetry. Severity disagreement: gemini=MAJOR, the others=NIT. Sonnet-5_5 declined to raise it because it could not confirm that §30 requires a fragment.

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:3385-3449 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Failed push attempts never return the clone_ms, write_ms and push_ms timing fields.
  WHY: When every push attempt fails, the loop raises without returning the timing dict. The caller in scripts/memory_helpers.sh (lines 133-149) then reports only total duration and error category. The test_record_run_event_telemetry_defaults_phase_timings_to_zero test covers only the no-change path.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:672-696 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fail-closed listing call discards stderr, so reason=dedup_list_failed carries no distinguishing cause.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell a transient 5xx from a permission error or a rate limit. The GH_API_RETRY diagnostics emitted by gh_retry are discarded as well.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "If behavior changes: update README.md / agents.md with env vars, DB behavior, indexes, operational steps, failure modes. Additions to agents.md go in an agents.d/ fragment (§30)." (CLAUDE.md §7)
  Expected change site: agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md, a new fragment documenting the five operator-visible behavior changes.
  Evidence of absence: pr_changed_files.txt contains no agents.d/*.md file. The PR adds five changelog.d fragments but no agents.d fragment. The changes add a dedup_list_failed exit, a merge-train upsert warning, cross-repo PR exclusion, a label-ensure cache and clone_ms/write_ms/push_ms telemetry.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:693-696 (relative to the base-branch gate at 720+ and the duplicate-skip path at 698-707) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new fail-closed dedup abort sits before the base-branch gate (#7020) and PR-head routing. A transient listing failure now ends the run with exit 1 even when the correct outcome was a base-gate skip or a duplicate-skip.
  WHY: A PR-specific failure on a green base branch now red-fails instead of skipping. Collect-stage triggers have no automatic re-run, and the fail-closed guarantee from #8126 only needs to refuse issue creation, so it could sit immediately before gh issue create.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:878-880 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed marker-comment lookup now returns 1 without attempting any write. Previously the empty existing_id fell through to the POST branch.
  WHY: On a transient failure of the comments read, the released-status marker comment is never written. The caller only warns and continues, so the on-PR record is silently absent until a later run.
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:679-683 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fail-closed path discards stderr and does not capture the gh exit status, so reason=dedup_list_failed carries no distinguishing cause.
  WHY: A gh_retry rate-limit stop (exit 75), a 5xx, a pagination failure and a jq projection error all log the identical line.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:868-873 and changelog.d/8127-merge-train-upsert-status.md | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The function contract comment and the changelog describe the new return values, but the changelog records only the write-status change and the gate warning, not the lookup-failure behavior change.
  WHY: No runtime failure. This is a documentation and behavior mismatch for an observable change.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Operator-visible behavior changes must be recorded in the agents file via an agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md fragment (repo convention; CLAUDE.md §30 pattern).
  Expected change site: agents.d/8126-8130-*.md (new fragments under the existing "Stable log prefixes (contractual)" / operational sections)
  Evidence of absence: pr_changed_files.txt contains no agents.d/*.md file. Only changelog.d/*.md fragments and the analysis report document the changes.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
Notes: HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
- HARDENING scripts/check_failure_triage.sh:679-683: capture the exit status, redirect stderr to a temp file, and append rc=<n> plus one sanitized stderr line to the log, about 4 lines.
- HARDENING scripts/review_merge_train.sh:878-880: on lookup failure include the failure context, or return a distinct code such as 2, so the two _mt_warn call sites (lines 997-1004 and 1418-1419) can name the cause, about 3 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
